tools.name: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit
tools.description: Compare a caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 document and its XSD documents, including an optional previous set. audit_status is valid, warnings, breaking_changes, invalid, or incomplete. Imports are not downloaded. A schema difference is syntactic and is not proof that a SOAP client fails at runtime. Price $

tools.name: soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree
tools.description: Read import, include, and complexType names from the supplied XML. A document cycle, or a complex type that references itself, sets the circular flag. The score counts types, imports, and non-builtin references. schemaLocation values are not downloaded. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/soap-contracts/

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "soap-contracts" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Private data: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Public sink: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Destructive: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Private data: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Public sink: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree · Destructive: soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit, soap-contracts_schema-dependency-tree

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
